title.en: An estimate and its standard error

hints.tr:
Çözümün tamamı:

**main.py**

```python
import numpy as np
from ab_data import make_population

users = make_population()
x = users.sample(n=200, random_state=31)["minutes"]
se = x.std() / np.sqrt(len(x))
print(round(x.mean(), 2))
print(round(x.std(), 2))
print(round(se, 3))
```
